title: Ndop item release
description: Release registry items (ADR-0012, ADR-0020): set each item's version in registry.json and add its changelog section. Build the registry afterwards to write the new snapshots.

to.description: The new version, major.minor.patch, for every item named. Use either this or bump.

bump.description: Raise each item's own version. Use either this or to.

notes.description: The changelog section's text. {previous} stands for each item's version before the release.
